purpose: Phase 5 remote-sensing vision-language adaptation (LoRA on CLIP)
split_source: official `split` column of BigEarthNet.txt (no custom splitting)

imagery.provenance_warning: Publisher declares this an UNOFFICIAL pre-conversion of the official BigEarthNet v2.0 release (10.5281/zenodo.10891137), converted with rico-hdl (the officially recommended converter). Pairing is validated against the official annotation file.
imagery.sentinel1_note: Sentinel-1 is present in the LMDB and recorded, but Phase 5 trains on Sentinel-2 RGB only. No optical-SAR fusion is learned here (that is Phase 7).

stretch.method: per-image joint percentile stretch across B04/B03/B02
stretch.rationale: Measured raw uint16 RGB values in this subset: p50=277, p99=528, max=1148. A fixed ceiling of 3000 produced near-black images (mean 24/255), so a per-image stretch matching the inference-time renderer is used instead.
